name: Untrusted: hackers at large
detailed_description:
Untrusted: Hackers at Large

A single-player hacking adventure set in the Untrusted universe.

Step into the shadows of the late 1970s in this gritty, story-driven prequel to Untrusted. In Untrusted: Hackers at Large, you'll manage an underground crew of digital operatives in a world where your every choice matters.

Infiltrate networks. Exploit vulnerabilities. Control the narrative.

Features

Realistic Hacking Mechanics
Explore an authentic command-line-inspired interface (with optional mouse-friendly commands). Whether you're into realism or just want to get things done, some typing is required. Read files, exploit vulnerabilities, or use brute force: the choice is yours.

Crew Management Across the Globe
Command a network of skilled hackers: coordinate attacks, manage risk, and adapt your strategy as the digital landscape evolves.

Deduction Meets Strategy
Analyze systems. Identify weak points. Make decisions that ripple through the storyline and impact your crew’s survival.

A Unique Hacking x Management x RPG Blend
A hacking-focused game with some RPG and management elements: tactical gameplay meets narrative-driven decisions in a tight single-player experience. You're not just a hacker.

Set in an Alternate Late-70s Timeline
Analog paranoia meets digital rebellion where nothing is safe. Immerse yourself in a retro setting where history took a darker turn.

Hack. Don't die. These are the rules.

If you're into grounded hacking mechanics and high-stakes choices, you’ll feel right at home.

Join our Discord to connect with the community, share strategies, and help shape the future of the Untrusted universe.

short_description: A single player hacking adventure set in the Untrusted world where you'll be playing as various hackers getting into computer systems to hack, steal and sabotage. Manage your crew, manage your risks, threaten or kill your targets. Investigate. Hack. Don't Die.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian
